title: Optimal Embedding of Wiring Diagrams in Constrained Three-Dimensional Spaces
summary: This paper investigates the \emph{Wiring Diagram Problem} (WDP), a three-dimensional layout design problem arising in industrial applications such as cable harness design and pipeline routing in constrained environments. In these settings, hierarchical tree-like systems composed of supply units, intermediate devices (e.g., valves or junctions), and terminal components must be spatially arranged and interconnected while satisfying stringent engineering requirements, including safety separation distances, obstacle avoidance, geometric feasibility, and constructibility constraints.
